tts_reference.audio: LPCNet resynthesis of the cue's TTS features (same pipeline as decoder output)

target_reference: held-out attempted only: LPCNet resynthesis of the aligned training target (decoder_target, smoothed + scaled, mapped back to LPCNet's range)
asr: wvx.asr.evaluate_wav(wav: 'np.ndarray', sr: 'int', reference_text: 'str', cfg: 'ConfigLike' = None) -> 'dict' with cfg {'asr': {'cpu_threads': 4, 'model': {'allow_download': False}, 'per': {'allow_download': False}}}; versions {'faster-whisper': '1.2.1', 'ctranslate2': '4.8.3', 'tokenizers': '0.23.3', 'huggingface-hub': '2.2.0', 'g2p-en': '2.1.0', 'nltk': '3.10.3'}
caveats: Targets were aligned with the day-193 decoder's own output on these attempted trials (D-020), so target-based scores (target_*, feat_corr_mean) of the zero-shot model are partly circular; the target-free mel_corr vs TTS is the primary metric.
mel_corr uses DTW, which raises the floor for unrelated speech (METRICS.md 2.5); compare with the nulls.
leaky_imagined sets: their cues were trained on (attempted); not a clean generalization test.
